baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence gives the Book, makes it guidance, and then forbids taking any wakil apart from God.
baseline_models.mechanism: A transferred written object is assigned the function of gentle direction, while the closing prohibition reserves ultimate delegation to its giver. The Book mediates direction without becoming a rival principal: guidance is authorized mediation under undivided custody.

activation_trace.role: The giving image supplies the initiating transfer and makes the Book received rather than self-produced.
The written-object image gives the transferred medium a durable and readable form.
The making-into-a-state image assigns the Book its operative status as guidance.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the Book's directional function.
The acquisition image makes the prohibited relation an actively installed dependency.
The other-than image marks the rival locus to which authority could be diverted.
Entrusting an affair to another supplies the fiduciary relation that the prohibition limits.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a scripture and adds a general command to trust God.
changed_reading.after: The verse constructs an authorized chain of agency: God gives, the Book directs, and no rival may receive ultimate delegation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Book is made huda specifically for bani Isra'il, followed by a warning against acquired reliance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book's joined and written form holds a way together; huda contributes a direction, manner, and sustained course; bani names a lineage generated from a source. The result is not information owned by an ethnic label but an assembled way meant to shape a continuing collective without transferring its final dependence elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the Book's capacity to hold a composite way together.
Making something assume a condition turns the assembled Book into an active communal orientation.
Direction, manner, and intended course supply the repeatable way that the collective can enact.
Lineage and derivation from a source make the addressee a continuing generational body.
Reliance on another supplies the counter-movement that could displace enactment of the given way.

changed_reading.before: A named people receive a sacred text for guidance.
changed_reading.after: A continuing lineage receives an assembled, practicable course whose enactment must not be replaced by rival dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding movement is nocturnal, directed between sites, and ordered toward being shown signs; hearing and sight close the scene. This turns the focus huda from a static instruction set into traveled disclosure: a route is traversed, its markers are shown, and its sense must be received.

activation_trace.role: Direction, manner, and intended course anchor the travel-shaped reading in the focus word huda.
Night travel supplies actual movement along a course and activates huda as wayfinding.
Showing and making visible supplies disclosure along the route rather than bare relocation.
The manifest-sign image supplies route markers by which direction becomes legible.
Understanding and complying supplies the receptive action required by displayed guidance.
Inner sight supplies discernment of what the shown signs mean for the route.

structural_cues: 17:1 moves from night travel between two sites to a purpose clause of showing signs, then closes with hearing and sight.
17:2 immediately assigns the Book the noun huda.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement, shown signs, hearing, and sight; I infer a wayfinding arrow from that sequence to the focus huda. A live alternative is that 17:1 only frames divine power and does not specify how the Book guides.

changed_reading.before: The Book contains propositions that identify a correct way.
changed_reading.after: The Book functions as disclosure encountered in motion: it orients a traveler through signs that must be perceived and followed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee's lineage is placed beside dispersed descendants, carriage with Nuh, obedient service, and gratitude. Bani therefore becomes a transmission relation: the gifted Book is carried as a binding trust through survival, and the fitting posture is grateful service under the one sufficient keeper.

activation_trace.role: Lineage derived from a source anchors the intergenerational addressee.
A written fixing that obliges supplies the durable trust borne across generations.
The sufficient keeper image reserves final custody while human carriers remain servants.
Smallness and dispersal supply the many descendants through whom transmission must continue.
Visible carriage supplies the survival-bearing movement that carries the lineage forward.
Bearing a trust or burden converts physical carriage into a model of custodial transmission.
Humble obedience supplies the carrier's proper relation to the giver.
Recognition of a gift and praise of its giver supplies the response opposed to rival reliance.

structural_cues: 17:2 addresses bani Isra'il and 17:3 immediately addresses descendants of those carried with Nuh.
The carried lineage is characterized through the servant's gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lineage, carriage, service, and gratitude; I infer that survival-carriage becomes an analogy for carrying the Book as trust. The live alternative is a narrower genealogical reminder with no claim about textual custody.

changed_reading.before: Bani Isra'il is simply the historical recipient group.
changed_reading.after: The name activates a chain of descendants charged to carry a binding gift gratefully, without mistaking carriers for the ultimate keeper.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Book that guides also communicates a decisive forecast of corruption and repetition. Dispatch, reversal, renewed return, mercy, and enclosure then form a feedback cycle. Guidance is therefore not only an ideal route but a prior diagnostic map of deviation and consequence; proximate actors execute turns in the cycle without becoming ultimate wakils.

activation_trace.role: Written fixing as judgment or decree anchors the Book's forecasting and diagnostic force.
Indication toward truth anchors the forecast as guidance rather than fatalistic information.
The sufficient keeper image distinguishes ultimate governance from agents operating within the cycle.
A decisive communication or bequest supplies the forecast embedded in the Book.
Departure from soundness supplies the deviation that guidance makes diagnosable.
Temporal occurrence and repetition supply the explicitly recurrent structure.
Sending and directing an emissary supplies proximate agency within the larger governance.
Returning something to its place supplies reversal within the feedback cycle.
Return after departure supplies the conditional recurrence linking conduct and response.
Confinement and enclosure supply the terminal constraint when the cycle closes adversely.

structural_cues: 17:4 places the forecast in the Book and explicitly marks two occurrences.
17:5-8 alternate dispatch, incursion, restored capacity, conditional mercy, return, and enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decisive notice, corruption, repetition, dispatched actors, reversal, return, and confinement; I infer a feedback architecture and distinguish its agents from its ultimate keeper. A live alternative is that the sequence is only a historical prediction and does not redefine huda.

changed_reading.before: Guidance describes the route that should be followed.
changed_reading.after: Guidance also maps recurrent failure and consequence in advance, making history itself an inspectable feedback process under one ultimate governor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recited corpus repeats the guiding function and immediately specifies uprightness, settled trust, work, and repair. The Mosaic Book's huda is thereby activated as a recurring scriptural operation that raises readers into stable practice, not a possession exhausted by having received a text.

activation_trace.role: The written corpus anchors the comparison with a later recited corpus.
Gentle indication to road and truth supplies the repeated scriptural function.
Reading and recitation supply the enacted mode in which the corpus continues to guide.
The repeated guidance image explicitly reactivates the focus function.
Straightness, balance, and upright stability specify the posture produced by guidance.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward uptake of the guiding direction.
Intentional work supplies the outward enactment by which guidance becomes operative.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the practical outcome of upright action.

structural_cues: 17:9 gives the recited corpus the same guiding verb used by the focus noun.
The sentence moves directly from guidance to uprightness and then to believers doing sound deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a recited corpus, repeated guidance, uprightness, trust, and sound work; I infer functional continuity with the focus Book without identifying the two textual moments. A live alternative is that they are parallel examples whose functions should not be read through one another.

changed_reading.before: The Mosaic Book is a past gift possessed by its named recipients.
changed_reading.after: Its huda exemplifies a repeatable scriptural event: recitation continually aligns inward trust with upright, repairing action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human calling can aim at harm with the same form used to seek benefit, because haste collapses the distinction. Guidance thus operates before commitment: it discriminates among desires, while the warning against acquired reliance blocks impulsive installation of a power merely because it answers an immediate call.

activation_trace.role: Indication toward truth anchors the corrective discrimination in the focus huda.
Acquiring something for oneself supplies the commitment that haste can misdirect.
Reliance supplies the relationship that should follow discernment rather than impulse.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies the formally similar petitions for harm and benefit.
Harm and evil supply the self-damaging object that desire can mistakenly summon.
Inclination toward useful good supplies the intended object with which harmful calling is confused.
Haste and premature advancement supply the cause of collapsed discrimination.

structural_cues: 17:11 repeats the same calling root for evil and good before characterizing the human as hasty.
The focus places huda before the prohibition on taking a wakil.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formally parallel calls for harm and benefit plus haste; I infer that huda corrects desire before reliance is installed. A live alternative is that 17:11 diagnoses prayer alone and has no bearing on the focus wakil relation.

changed_reading.before: Guidance selects the correct destination after a person has decided what to seek.
changed_reading.after: Guidance also audits the desire itself, slowing a hasty caller before that caller acquires a damaging object of reliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The public Book's fixed standard is followed by detailed signs, an attached and opened personal book, a command to read, self-sufficient accounting, nontransferable burden, prior message, binding command, and informed judgment. The prohibition on taking a wakil now includes nondelegable answerability: no proxy can own, read, or bear the moral account in one's place.

activation_trace.role: Written fixing that imposes judgment supplies the public standard against which an account can be read.
Delegating an affair to another anchors the question of whether accountability can be transferred.
Detailing parts and meanings supplies a legible standard rather than an undifferentiated command.
Binding and attaching by judgment supplies the personal account's nontransferable connection to its subject.
The written-object image turns the public medium of guidance into an individually encountered record.
The opened or published book image supplies disclosure of the record for inspection.
Reading and recitation supply the subject's direct encounter with the record.
Being enough supplies the explicit exclusion of a substitute accountant.
Counting and accounting supply the audit function of the exposed book.
The heavy burden image makes responsibility explicitly nontransferable between persons.
Messenger and message supply notice before punitive accounting.
Demand and obligation supply the actionable command against which conduct is measured.
Fixed obligation and deserved consequence supply the binding result of the audit.
Knowledge of report and inner reality supplies informed rather than arbitrary judgment.

structural_cues: 17:12 ends by detailing every thing; 17:13-14 then attach, expose, and command the reading of an individual book.
17:15 denies burden transfer and places a messenger before punishment.
17:16-17 move from command and binding consequence to knowledge of servants' deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a detailed standard, attached personal record, direct reading, self-accounting, nontransferable burden, prior message, command, and informed judgment; I infer that the personal book instantiates the public Book's audit function. A live alternative is that the two books remain separate motifs and only the burden statement supports nondelegability.

changed_reading.before: Not taking another wakil concerns worship or protection while the Book supplies communal teaching.
changed_reading.after: It also concerns answerability: the communal standard becomes a personal, readable account that no representative can absorb or discharge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate and later-oriented wills diverge, yet divine extension and giving reach both and are not barred; only afterward are degrees and greater preference exposed. Receipt therefore cannot certify direction. The Book guides desire and striving toward an end, while the anti-wakil clause prevents material supply from being mistaken for proof that a chosen dependency is ultimate or approved.

activation_trace.role: Giving anchors the distinction between receiving a provision and rightly reading its source or purpose.
Direction and intended course supply the criterion that material receipt alone lacks.
Reliance supplies the relation that must not be inferred merely from who or what appears to provide.
Will and intention supply the first horizon toward which desire is directed.
Acceleration and premature advancement define the immediate horizon.
Laterness after what comes first supplies the contrasting extended horizon.
Purposeful movement toward an object supplies the enacted orientation that distinguishes the two horizons.
Connected increase that supports another supplies provision extended to both groups.
Giving and handing over supply the common receipt that does not by itself distinguish direction.
Blocking from what is permitted supplies the negated restriction: the giving is not withheld.
Degree and excellence supply a ranking not visible from common material extension alone.
Stepwise degree supplies the differentiated outcome toward which guidance orients striving.

structural_cues: 17:18-19 contrast willing the immediate with willing the later and striving for it.
17:20 extends the same divine giving to both groups without restriction.
17:21 then commands comparison and distinguishes degrees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent wills, common extension, unrestricted giving, and later ranking; I infer that provision does not entail endorsement and so cannot validate a rival reliance. A live alternative is that the common gift only displays generosity and has no epistemic function.

changed_reading.before: A beneficial receipt may indicate that the source relied upon is a legitimate protector.
changed_reading.after: Receipt is ambiguous because provision reaches opposed orientations; guidance is needed to judge the end, and apparent supply cannot authorize an alternative wakil.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing prohibition against making another deity with God mirrors the focus prohibition against taking a wakil apart from Him. The paired installation verbs sharpen wakil from a casual helper into a rival locus of ultimate dependence; the resulting sitting, blame, and separation portray such delegation as collapse of agency rather than its security.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself supplies the deliberate installation of the rival relation.
Otherness and lower rank identify the displaced object of ultimate dependence.
Entrusting the affair to another anchors the prohibited dependency in the focus.
Making something assume a status supplies the parallel act of installing a rival.
The worshipped object supplies the explicit endpoint of rivalized dependence.
Another after or beside the first supplies the competing locus in the closing command.
Sitting back from action supplies the agency failure produced by false delegation.
Blame and fault supply the evaluative consequence of installing the rival.
Separation from one's supporting group supplies the abandonment hidden inside the promised dependency.

structural_cues: 17:2 and 17:22 are both negative second-person commands pairing God with an installed other.
The focus uses taking plus wakil; the closing verse uses making plus another deity and follows it with immobilization, blame, and abandonment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored prohibitions, deliberate installation, rival deity, sitting, blame, and abandonment; I infer that they mutually specify one prohibited architecture of ultimate dependence. A live alternative is that the commands target distinct errors, practical reliance in 17:2 and worship in 17:22.

changed_reading.before: The focus warns only against appointing an ordinary representative or protector.
changed_reading.after: It warns against installing any rival center of ultimate dependence, an act that ends in blamed isolation and loss of agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates concrete travel and animal-gait branches rather than the ordinary abstract senses. It remains anchored in three focus-root branches whose images form a coherent route-control contrast. Downstream prose should present it only as a lexical-material analogy, not as a translation of huda or wakil.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places huda before the rejected wakil, while its branch inventory also offers a road, a guide at the front, and a mount that lags by leaning on its companion.

activation_trace.role: The traveled-road image supplies the spatial field in which guidance and delegation can be contrasted.
The one advancing at the front supplies guidance as leading movement.
The lagging animal that leans on its companion supplies failed delegated locomotion.

changed_reading.before: A wakil is rejected as a theological substitute.
changed_reading.after: In the exploratory route image, the command rejects handing direction to what itself lags and depends, while huda advances at the front.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the watercourse sense of the focus giving-root is remote from the surface verb. It remains anchored through that supplied focus branch and is activated by later river and replenishing-flow branches. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for transmission and continuity, never as the lexical meaning of atayna.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins giving to huda, and one supplied branch for the giving-root images a channel that directs water.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse that channels and eases flow supplies a material model for how the given Book conducts guidance.
Gentle direction toward a road supplies the orienting function carried by the flow analogy.
A river cutting the ground with running water supplies a visible channel through which movement becomes ordered.
Water that flows, fills, and is replenished by other water supplies continuity of the transmitted guidance.

changed_reading.before: The Book is handed over as a bounded object containing guidance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the gift opens a channel in which guidance arrives, runs, and is continually replenished.

strongest_changes: The Book becomes both route and diagnostic feedback map, not only a store of correct propositions.
The anti-wakil command expands into nondelegable personal accountability when the public Book becomes an attached, readable account.
Common provision to opposed orientations means receipt cannot certify the legitimacy of a dependency.
The closing ban on making another deity sharpens wakil into a rival center of ultimate reliance whose promise of agency ends in abandonment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's giving-making-guiding-taking sequence supported one coherent agency model, while the ordered context repeatedly changed its scale: traveled perception, generational custody, recurrent history, enacted uprightness, corrected desire, personal audit, ambiguous provision, and finally rivalized dependence.
remaining_uncertainties: The link between physical carriage in 17:3 and carrying the Book as trust is abductive rather than explicit.
The personal book in 17:13 may be adjacent to, rather than an instantiation of, the public Book in 17:2.
The route-leader and water-flow outliers depend on form-distant branch images and should remain exploratory.
